mapper.select: select from lab_inspection_task t where t.id=#{taskId} and t.del_flag='0'
select from lab_inspection_task t where t.id=#{taskId} and t.del_flag='0' for update
select count(1) from lab_inspection_task where plan_id=#{planId} and scheduled_at=#{scheduledAt} and del_flag='0'
mapper.update: update lab_inspection_task set status='IN_PROGRESS',started_at=#{startedAt},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=#{startedAt},version=version+1 where id=#{taskId} and status='PENDING' and version=#{expectedVersion} and del_flag='0'

update lab_inspection_task set status='COMPLETED',completed_at=#{completedAt},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=#{completedAt},version=version+1 where id=#{taskId} and status='IN_PROGRESS' and version=#{expectedVersion} and del_flag='0'

update lab_inspection_task set overdue_flag='1',overdue_set_at=#{now},overdue_event_version=overdue_event_version+1,update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=#{now},version=version+1 where id in (select id from (select id from lab_inspection_task where deadline_at < #{now} and status <> 'COMPLETED' and overdue_flag='0' and del_flag='0' order by id limit #{batchSize}) due)
